nom: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hydrating Facial Cleansing Gel

segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report the gel is gentle with no irritation, several specifically recommending it for sensitive skin, but one reviewer says it provoked acne, irritation, and increased dryness and sensitivity within a week, and another warns those sensitive to fragrance specifically to be cautious of the scent.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some who describe it as extra dry, consistently say the gel hydrates well without stripping, though one reviewer notes those with very dry skin or a specific skin condition may still need a richer product alongside it.
segments.oily: Most reviewers with oily skin say it removes oil and dirt effectively while keeping their skin balanced and hydrated rather than tight, though one reviewer with oily skin says it leaves a residue and she prefers a cleanser that strips more thoroughly.
segments.combination: Most reviewers with combination skin say it cleans thoroughly while keeping skin hydrated and balanced, calling it well-suited for normal-to-combination skin, but one reviewer with combination skin and previously clear skin says it caused a severe breakout that only worsened the longer she continued using it.
segments.mature: The reviewers who mention mature or middle-aged skin say it leaves their face clean without irritation or dryness, one calling it the only cleansing product she needs alongside a moisturizer.

concerns.aging: The one reviewer who mentions an anti-aging effect says the hyaluronic acid gives her a firmer, more supple, and vibrant look after cleansing.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers say the gel leaves skin hydrated, soft, and never tight, frequently crediting the hyaluronic acid; however, a few reviewers report the opposite — skin left more dry and sensitized, and in one case stripped to the point of peeling.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer says the formula triggered an atopic dermatitis (eczema) flare-up that was difficult to resolve, and a separate reviewer describes the cleanser as so stripping that her face began to peel and a wound opened after continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers say the gel doesn't clog pores or cause breakouts, and one credits it with finally clearing her skin after a long struggle, but two reviewers report the opposite: a severe new breakout, in one case starting after two to three days and worsening the longer she continued.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers with oily skin say it removes excess oil while keeping their skin balanced, though one reviewer with oily skin says it doesn't cleanse deeply enough and leaves a residual film she'd rather not feel.

aspects.libelle: Outperforms pricier cleansers for the cost
A little goes a long way
Gel transforms into a light foam

extraits.texte: I bought this product with a completely clear face, 0 breakouts. I haven't had any issues with breakouts in months. I have combination skin and I was just looking for a good hydrating cleanser to use as we move into the colder months - thinking this would help hence the name. Upon day 2 to 3 of use my face began to break out horribly! I attributed this to the "purge" phase, and continued use. This was the WORST mistake I could've made because it has only gotten so so much worse! I'm devastated. I will also add that there is really nothing hydrating about the product either. I'm not sure what I was expecting, but I do know that this product falls way below even the most basic cheap cleansers. I believe they really bombed on this one. I've never had a product be so opposite of it's uses and claims - to the point that it reversed the quality of my skin and actually caused harm.
For my sensitive skin it's a hazard. It provoked acne and irritation. It is too hard for my skin type. Skin becomes more sensitive and dry after a week of using.
It's a gentle cleanser for sure, but something in this gave me an atopic dermatitis flare-up (eczema) that was really hard to shift.

This cleansing gel is really hydrating, it is a gentle cleanser so if you have dry skin this would be perfect, it's ok but I have oily skin and I like my skin to feel super clean, I don't want my face to still feel like it has something on it and that is the feeling this gives me, I like for the oils to be remove off my face, for my skin to be really clean, that's just what I like, it has no smell which is nice if you prefer that, I will use this as my second cleanser after going with a cleanser that I actually feel like takes all the gunk, the day off my face but the 4 stars stand because it's not bad, I just prefer a cleanser that takes the day off my face.
I hope you always have this product. I have struggled with my skin breaking out until using this. My skin is clearer and I can even use your moisturizer with no breakouts. Thank you!

extraits.texte: I have used the hydro boost MOISTURIZERs for several years now and many other products in the hydro boost line and i am TOTALLY in love with this cleanser and it smells amazing! Its the first gel cleanser ever that does not strip my skin!

My daughter left her partially used bottle at my house several years ago, so I thought I'd give this a try. …this is now the only product I use to cleanse my face. Leaves my skin fresh and clean…never any irritation, never dry. Along with a good moisturizer, this is the only product needed to keep my skin looking healthy.
